WITH chan AS (
  SELECT s.period,
         c.channel,
         SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty,
         SUM(s.revenue_cad) AS total_revenue,
         SUM(s.qty * p.wholesale_price_cad) AS total_cost_wholesale
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line s
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.product p ON s.sku = p.sku
  WHERE s.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
  GROUP BY s.period, c.channel
),
totals AS (
  SELECT period,
         SUM(total_qty) AS period_total_qty,
         SUM(total_revenue) AS period_total_revenue
  FROM chan
  GROUP BY period
)
SELECT chan.period,
       chan.channel,
       chan.total_qty,
       chan.total_revenue,
       chan.total_cost_wholesale,
       (chan.total_revenue - chan.total_cost_wholesale) AS gross_margin_cad,
       chan.total_qty * 100.0 / totals.period_total_qty AS qty_share_pct,
       chan.total_revenue * 100.0 / totals.period_total_revenue AS revenue_share_pct
FROM chan
JOIN totals ON chan.period = totals.period
ORDER BY chan.period, chan.channel
